contradictions_fixed: https://github.com/timescale/timescaledb appears in both merit.shortlist and merit.dropped (with a dropped 'why' text explicitly stating 'NOT dropped mechanically (kept eligible)'). Correct reading: it is shortlisted -- the dual dual/Apache-2.0 core license passes the license rule -- and the merit.dropped entry is an erroneous duplicate flag that should be removed from the dropped list, not a real drop.

https://github.com/OpenBB-finance/OpenBB appears in both merit.shortlist and merit.dropped (with a dropped 'why' text explicitly stating 'NOT dropped mechanically (kept eligible, in shortlist)'). Correct reading: it is shortlisted -- AGPL-3.0 passes the license rule -- and the merit.dropped entry is an erroneous duplicate flag that should be removed from the dropped list, not a real drop.

https://github.com/man-group/ArcticDB is recorded in merit.dropped, but its own 'why' text states it was 'NOT dropped mechanically (kept eligible)' (BSL 1.1 counts as explicit commercial/source-available terms, passing the license rule) and it names no violated rule; it is also not in merit.shortlist. Correct reading: it should be reclassified as rule-pass-cut-by-cap (passed every mechanical rule, excluded from the shortlist only by the 12-slot cap), not recorded under merit.dropped, which is reserved for genuine rule-driven exclusions.
